Container.Name: JDownloader
Container.Overview:
JDownloader 2 with a sleek, modern DARK MODE GUI out of the box — a complete KDE Breeze Dark interface where the download list, link grabber AND settings are all dark (not just the menu bar), on a smooth, hardware-accelerated KasmVNC web desktop. No tweaking, no add-ons — it just looks great from the first start.
What's pre-configured: • Full Dark Mode by default — JD Plain Dark (flat icons + Breeze Dark colours), shown in a clean maximised kiosk window (no title-bar clutter). • Switch to a matching Light theme any time via the Theme variable. • Auto-installs and self-updates JDownloader on first start. • Persistent config and downloads in /config and /downloads.
Notes: • FIRST START takes a few minutes: JDownloader installs itself + its dark theme. The WebUI stays BLACK until done — this is normal, do NOT restart. Watch the container log and wait for the "JDOWNLOADER IS READY" banner. • First start only: JDownloader may ask ONCE to install its design and a few extensions — click [OK] / [Install now]. After that it stays dark, no prompts. • The WebUI opens via HTTPS (port 3001, self-signed cert — accept the browser warning once). HTTPS enables SEAMLESS CLIPBOARD: copy on your PC and paste straight into JD. Plain HTTP (3000) is also exposed, but browsers block the clipboard over HTTP, so there you'd use KasmVNC's clipboard panel instead. • PUID/PGID default to 99/100 (nobody/users on Unraid). • Auth: leave Username and Password EMPTY for no login.
Source on GitHub: https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/jdownloader

Config.Name: WebUI Port (HTTP / KasmVNC)
Config.Description: Plain HTTP WebUI. Browsers block seamless clipboard over HTTP — prefer HTTPS (3001).

Config.Name: WebUI Port (HTTPS / KasmVNC)
Config.Description: HTTPS WebUI (self-signed TLS) — the WebUI button opens this; required for seamless clipboard.

Config.Name: AppData (/config)
Config.Description: Persistent JDownloader install, configs, and session data.

Config.Name: Theme (JD_THEME)
Config.Description: Dark = JD Plain Dark (flat icons, Breeze Dark colours). Light = JD Plain (flat icons, light colours).

Config.Name: KasmVNC Username
Config.Description: Optional. Username for HTTP-basic-auth. Leave EMPTY with password for no login.

Config.Name: User ID (PUID)
Config.Description: User-ID JDownloader runs as. Default 99 (nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permission mask for newly created files.
